I've answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. It's **Pine Crossing**.

- **Source:** her own 9 June post in #central-team. The Pine Crossing morning receiver reported that the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note instead.
- **Status:** Hollis said he would check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login. Nothing in that channel since then says it was fixed. If the account sheet tracks status, she may want to check with Hollis.
